name: TagGroup
description: Tags to choose or remove, drawn as Flutter's chips.

label.description: The field's name, drawn above it.

isLabelHidden.description: Hides the label from sight; it still names the field for a screen reader.

errorMessage.description: Set means invalid: the field shows this message under it.

defaultSelectedKeys.description: Starts at this value; the merchant changes it.

selectedKeys.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree.

variant.description: surface is for tags on a grey card.

onRemove.description: A tag's remove button pressed; declaring it shows the buttons. Its value is the tag's id: send it with call's value.
